definitions.full: H7838. shachor שָׁחֹר adjective black ; — ׳שׁ of hair Lev 13:31 , 37 (P), so feminine plural שְׁחֹרוֺת Song 5:11 ; of skin, feminine singular שְׁחוֺרָה 1:5 ; of horses, masculine plural שְׁחֹרִים Zech 6:2 , 6 .

occurrences.englishText: If the priest examines the plague of itching, and behold, its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the person infected with itching seven days.
But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, then the itch is healed. He is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.
In the first chariot were red horses; in the second chariot black horses;
The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”
